Because the depth deficiencies are essentially equal, neither response demonstrably out‑performs the other in deep coverage.

consistency_internal.explantion: Response b, while suffering from false consensus, attribution failures, and blurred viewpoints, does not contain an unresolved conflict where contradictory claims are presented without reconciliation.
